summary: Embedded RSA private key for author's signing server in cli.js
details: cli.js embeds a base64-encoded RSA private key (CONFIG.encodedSSHKey) that is decoded and written to a 0600 temp file, then used with ssh/scp -i to connect as user 'ubuntu' to the hardcoded host 79.72.65.161. The key authorizes access to the author's own build/signing server and is invoked through the package's documented deploy CLI flow. The package does not read installer secrets, does not reconfigure the installer's package manager or tooling, has no install/import-time lifecycle side effects, and does not exfiltrate installer data. The exposed credential's blast radius is confined to the author's own infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
